functionDeclarations.name: propose_notification_read
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose notification.read for review; never apply it to the live books. Mark some of your own notifications as read, so the list stops showing them as new; do not use it to delete one or to touch someone else’s.
Example input: {"ids":["note_1","note_2"]}
INVALID_INPUT: No ids, or more than 200 at once. Send between one and two hundred notification ids.
UNAUTHENTICATED: The request has no signed-in person. Sign in and try again.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_numbering_update
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose numbering.update for review; never apply it to the live books. Set the prefix and next unused number for one document series; do not use this to renumber documents that have already been issued.
Example input: {"type":"invoice","prefix":"INV-2027-","nextNumber":1,"padding":4}
INVALID_INPUT: The type, prefix, number, or padding is malformed. Use a supported document type, an allowed prefix, a positive next number, and 1–10 padding digits.
NUMBER_ALREADY_USED: The requested next number is already used with the proposed prefix. Choose a next number greater than the highest number already used with that prefix.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not a workspace owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to change document numbering.
UNAUTHENTICATED: The request has no valid signed-in user or API key. Sign in or use a valid API key.
NOT_A_MEMBER: The caller is not a member of this workspace. Choose a workspace the caller belongs to.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.
WORKSPACE_SCOPE: An API key is scoped to a different workspace. Use a key scoped to this workspace.
INVALID_OPERATION_ID: The retry key is malformed. Use an operation key of 1–128 letters, digits, underscores, dots, colons, or hyphens.
CONFLICT: An idempotency key was already used for a different numbering change. Use a new idempotency key for a new change; reuse the old key only to retry the identical request.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payment_apply
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payment.apply for review; never apply it to the live books. Apply the unapplied part of a payment — a deposit or prepayment — to invoices or bills later; do not use it to record a new payment.
Example input: {"paymentId":"payment_123","allocations":[{"documentId":"invoice_123","documentType":"invoice","amountCents":3333}],"date":"2026-06-30"}
INVALID_INPUT: No allocation is named, or the date is not a real day. Send the invoice or bill and the amount, with a real date.
CONFLICT: The amount is more than is unapplied, the document is closed, or the dates and rates do not line up. Apply no more than the payment still holds, at that payment rate and on or after its date.
NOT_FOUND: The payment or a document is not in this workspace. Check the payment and document ids.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner for a writing role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payment_creditapply
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payment.creditapply for review; never apply it to the live books. Apply a credit note to a customer's invoice, or a vendor credit to a bill; do not use it to refund the credit as cash — that is payment.creditrefund.
Example input: {"kind":"customer","creditId":"credit_123","documentId":"invoice_123","amountCents":6000}
INVALID_INPUT: The kind, credit, document, amount or date is missing or malformed. Send kind, creditId, documentId, amountCents and, if you choose, a real date.
CONFLICT: The credit has no entry in the books, is smaller than the amount, or the document is settled. Apply no more than the credit and the document still allow.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner for a writing role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payment_creditrefund
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payment.creditrefund for review; never apply it to the live books. Refund a credit note or vendor credit as money, out of a bank or cash account; do not use it to settle an invoice — that is payment.creditapply.
Example input: {"kind":"customer","creditId":"credit_123","amountCents":4000,"cashAccountId":"acc_bank","date":"2026-06-30"}
INVALID_INPUT: The credit, amount, cash account or date is missing or malformed. Send a real credit, amount, cash account and date.
CONFLICT: The credit has no entry in the books, or is smaller than the refund. Refund no more than the credit still allows.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner for a writing role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payment_creditsautoapply
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payment.creditsautoapply for review; never apply it to the live books. Apply every open credit to the open invoices or bills of one contact, or of the whole workspace, oldest first; do not use it to refund a credit.
Example input: {"kind":"customer","partyId":"cust_123"}
INVALID_INPUT: The kind is missing or unknown. Send kind customer or vendor.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner for a writing role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payment_deposit
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payment.deposit for review; never apply it to the live books. Take the payments waiting in Undeposited Funds to a bank account in one entry; do not use it to record a payment from a customer.
Example input: {"bankAccountId":"acc_bank","paymentIds":["payment_1","payment_2"],"date":"2026-06-30"}
INVALID_INPUT: No payment is named, or the bank account is not a cash account of the books. Choose the payments waiting in Undeposited Funds and a real bank account.
CONFLICT: A payment is void, already deposited, or waiting in another Undeposited Funds account. Deposit only the payments still waiting in the same account.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner for a writing role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payment_receive
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payment.receive for review; never apply it to the live books. Record money received from a customer or paid to a vendor and apply it to open documents, and do not use it to create an invoice or bill.
Example input: {"amountCents":12500,"paymentDate":"2026-06-30","cashAccountId":"acc_bank","customerId":"cust_123","allocations":[{"documentId":"inv_123","documentType":"invoice","amountCents":12500}]}
INVALID_INPUT: The payment amount, date, cash account, payment type, or allocation is invalid. Correct the payment details and choose an existing cash account and open document.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The payment date is in a closed period. Choose an open date or ask an owner to reopen the period.
CONFLICT: The operation id was already used for different payment details. Use a new operation id for the changed request.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payment_void
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payment.void for review; never apply it to the live books. Void a payment so its entry and its ledger rows are reversed and its documents are due again; do not use it to correct one line — void and record the payment again.
Example input: {"paymentId":"payment_123","date":"2026-07-01","reason":"Cheque bounced"}
NOT_FOUND: The payment is not in this workspace. Check the payment id.
CONFLICT: The payment is already void, is inside a bank deposit, or the void date is before the payment or in a closed period. Undo the deposit first, and choose an open date on or after the payment.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner for a writing role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payroll_approval
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payroll.approval for review; never apply it to the live books. Turn the owner’s approval of payroll on or off; do not use it to approve a particular run — that is payroll.approve.
Example input: {"required":true}
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner. Ask a workspace owner to change it.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace does not exist. Check the workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payroll_approve
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payroll.approve for review; never apply it to the live books. Approve a pay run that is waiting, which posts it; do not use it on a run that already posted — that is payroll.undo.
Example input: {"payRunId":"payrun_123"}
CONFLICT: The run is not waiting, is incomplete, or the same day and amounts were already paid. Approve a complete run that still waits; reply with `again: true` for a deliberate second run.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner. Ask a workspace owner to approve it.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payroll_import
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payroll.import for review; never apply it to the live books. Record an outside payroll provider’s completed run as one journal per pay date from its CSV; use it for payroll accounting, not to run payroll or send pay.
Example input: {"provider":"gusto","csv":"Pay Date,Employee,Gross Earnings,Net Pay\n2026-06-15,Example Employee,100.00,100.00","fileName":"payroll-june.csv","accounts":{"wages":"acc_wages","clearing":"acc_payroll_clearing"}}
INVALID_INPUT: The provider, file or account mapping is missing or malformed. Choose ADP, Gusto or Paychex, a supported CSV export and the payroll accounts.
PAYROLL_FILE_INVALID: A file column, amount, label or account cannot be used. Read the file problems, correct the export or mapping, and preview again.
INVALID_OPERATION_ID: The operation ID does not have the required format. Use up to 128 letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, periods or colons.
PERIOD_LOCKED: At least one pay date is in a closed period. Ask an authorised person to review the closed period before importing; do not change the pay date in the file.
CONFLICT: The same payroll was already recorded, or the operation ID belongs to another request. Check the posted entries or retry the original request as sent; to correct a posting, reverse the affected entry first.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant of these books. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to import the file.
PERSON_ONLY: The caller used an API key. Sign in as an owner or accountant to import the file.

csv.description: The original provider export as CSV text, including the header row.

labelDimensionId.description: Workspace dimension used to split expenses by the label column in the file.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payroll_reject
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payroll.reject for review; never apply it to the live books. Send a waiting pay run back to whoever prepared it, with a note; do not use it to undo a run that already posted — that is payroll.undo.
Example input: {"payRunId":"payrun_123","note":"Wrong pay period"}
CONFLICT: The run is not waiting. Send back only a run that still waits.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner. Ask a workspace owner to review it.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payroll_run
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payroll.run for review; never apply it to the live books. Post a pay run for a pay date: one entry for the wages, the employer tax and what was withheld, with the net paid out of the bank; do not use it to record a single payment to one person — that is payment.receive.
Example input: {"date":"2026-06-30","bankAccountId":"acc_bank","wagesAccountId":"acc_wages","taxExpenseAccountId":"acc_tax","liabilitiesAccountId":"acc_payroll_liab"}
INVALID_INPUT: The pay date is not a real day, or an account is missing. Send a real pay date and the four accounts.
CONFLICT: The same day, schedule and amounts were already paid, or the run is in a closed period. Choose another day, or send `again: true` for a second run.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant to run payroll.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_payroll_undo
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose payroll.undo for review; never apply it to the live books. Undo a posted pay run while its date is open, or withdraw one still waiting for approval; do not use it to edit a payslip by hand.
Example input: {"payRunId":"payrun_123"}
NOT_FOUND: The run is not in this workspace. Check the run in this workspace.
CONFLICT: The pay date is in a closed period, or the run was already undone. Reopen the period first, or undo a run that stands.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_balancesrebuild
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.balancesrebuild for review; never apply it to the live books. Rebuild stale and missing closed-year balance snapshots from the ledger without changing entries; do not use this to edit accounting records.
Example input: {}
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not the workspace owner or a platform administrator. Ask the owner or a platform administrator to rebuild the snapshots.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_close
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.close for review; never apply it to the live books. Soft- or hard-close an ended accounting month after checking that no drafts would be trapped; do not use this to post or reverse a ledger entry.
Example input: {"month":"2026-03","mode":"soft"}
INVALID_INPUT: The month is malformed or has not ended. Choose an ended month in YYYY-MM format.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to close the period.
CONFLICT: The month is already closed or contains drafts that would be trapped. Choose an open month and post, re-date, or remove the listed drafts first.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_closesteps
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.closesteps for review; never apply it to the live books. Replace the workspace’s custom month-end checklist steps; do not use this to change built-in checks or their sign-offs.
Example input: {"steps":[{"title":"Review customer balances","frequency":"monthly"}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A step is malformed, duplicated, or uses an unsupported frequency. Provide unique step names of 2 to 120 characters and monthly, quarterly, or yearly frequency.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to edit the month-end checklist.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_depreciation
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.depreciation for review; never apply it to the live books. Post month-end depreciation for active fixed assets through a specified ended month; do not use this to dispose of an asset or change its depreciation method.
Example input: {"month":"2026-03"}
INVALID_INPUT: The month is malformed or has not ended. Choose an ended month in YYYY-MM format.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace writer to run depreciation.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The month-end posting date is closed for the caller. Choose an open month or ask an owner to reopen the period.
INVALID_INPUT: An eligible asset has no usable depreciation accounts. Choose an expense account and an accumulated-depreciation asset account for each affected asset.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_fxrevaluation
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.fxrevaluation for review; never apply it to the live books. Post a month-end foreign-currency revaluation of open invoices and bills with its next-day reversal; use the preview before posting and do not revalue home-currency documents.
Example input: {"date":"2026-03-31","rates":{"EUR":1.15}}
INVALID_INPUT: The date or a provided exchange rate is invalid, or a historical month-end is missing rates. Use an ended month-end and provide a positive rate for every open foreign currency.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to run the currency revaluation.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The revaluation date or its reversal date is closed. Choose an open month or ask the owner to reopen it.
CONFLICT: A revaluation already exists for that date. Undo the existing revaluation before running it again.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_fxrevaluationundo
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.fxrevaluationundo for review; never apply it to the live books. Undo one currency revaluation by posting its mirror and voiding the paired next-day reversal; do not use this to reverse unrelated journals.
Example input: {"date":"2026-03-31"}
INVALID_INPUT: The original date is malformed or omitted. Provide the original revaluation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to undo the revaluation.
CONFLICT: The original entry or scheduled reversal is missing, changed, or already reversed. Check the existing ledger entries before making another correction.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_relock
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.relock for review; never apply it to the live books. Close a temporarily unlocked date range again and rebuild affected balance snapshots; do not use this to change the workspace close date.
Example input: {}
CONFLICT: No dates are currently unlocked. Use this only after a partial period unlock.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to re-lock the dates.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_reopen
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.reopen for review; never apply it to the live books. Reopen a closed accounting month with a recorded reason; do not use this to change or reverse any ledger entries.
Example input: {"month":"2026-03","reason":"Correct a missed supplier bill"}
INVALID_INPUT: The month or reason is malformed. Use YYYY-MM and give a reason of at least five characters.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant, or an accountant tries to reopen a hard close. Ask the workspace owner to reopen a hard-closed period.
CONFLICT: The month is already open. Choose a closed month.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_signoff
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.signoff for review; never apply it to the live books. Record or remove a month-end checklist sign-off; do not use this to close a period or certify an unreviewed item.
Example input: {"month":"2026-03","itemId":"reconcile","note":"Bank lines match"}
INVALID_INPUT: The month or checklist item is malformed or unknown. Choose YYYY-MM and a built-in checklist item or a current workspace step.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace writer to record the review.
CONFLICT: The period is hard-closed and sign-offs are final. Do not alter the closed-period record; ask the owner to reopen it if correction is necessary.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_unlock
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.unlock for review; never apply it to the live books. Temporarily unlock up to three months inside a closed period with a reason; do not use this to reopen the entire period.
Example input: {"fromDate":"2026-01-10","toDate":"2026-01-20","reason":"Correct a dated bank entry"}
INVALID_INPUT: The date range is invalid, longer than three months, outside a closed period, or the reason is too short. Use real YYYY-MM-DD dates in ascending order, choose dates that are closed, stay within three months, and explain why.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant, or an accountant tries to unlock hard-closed dates. Ask the workspace owner to unlock hard-closed dates.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_period_yearclose
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose period.yearclose for review; never apply it to the live books. Record the profit or loss for a completed fiscal year and optionally lock through its closing date; no closing journal entry is posted.
Example input: {"closingDate":"2026-06-30","lockPeriod":true}
INVALID_INPUT: The closing date is malformed, invalid, or in the future. Provide a real ended date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not the workspace owner or a platform administrator. Ask the owner or a platform administrator to close the fiscal year.
CONFLICT: The period is already locked through or beyond the requested closing date. Choose a date after the current lock or reopen the later period first.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_portal_linkcreate
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose portal.linkcreate for review; never apply it to the live books. Mint the private link a customer uses to see their own invoices and balance; do not send it to anyone but that customer — it is a way into their account.
Example input: {"customerId":"cus_1"}
NOT_FOUND: The customer is not in this workspace. Reload the customer list.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_portal_linkrevoke
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose portal.linkrevoke for review; never apply it to the live books. Turn off a customer's portal link so it stops working; do not use it to hide an invoice — void or correct the invoice instead.
Example input: {"customerId":"cus_1"}
NOT_FOUND: The customer is not in this workspace. Reload the customer list.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_presence_beat
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose presence.beat for review; never apply it to the live books. Say that this person is still looking at this workspace, so the collaborator list can show them; do not use it to mark anyone else present — the row is always the caller’s own.
Example input: {"name":"Dana","color":"#3366ff"}
INVALID_INPUT: There is no display name. Send the name the presence list should show.
NOT_A_MEMBER: The caller is not a member of the workspace. Open a workspace the person belongs to.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_presence_leave
propose_project_create
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose project.create for review; never apply it to the live books. Create a new active project, with an optional code, manager and budget limit; this does not create or move any ledger entries.
Example input: {"name":"Fit-out","code":"FIT","budgetLimitCents":12300}
INVALID_INPUT: The project has no name or the fields are not valid. Supply a name and check the fields.
PAYMENT_REQUIRED: The developer API credit balance is exhausted. Check the workspace billing settings.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The developer API spending limit was reached. Ask an administrator to check the workspace quota.

budgetLimitCents.description: Budget in whole cents; the legacy API also accepts a numeric string

functionDeclarations.name: propose_project_delete
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose project.delete for review; never apply it to the live books. Delete one project and answer with the row that was removed, so it can be restored; do not use it to remove the documents that point at the project — they keep their own rows.
Example input: {"id":"proj_web"}
NOT_FOUND: The project is not in the selected workspace, or is already gone. Reload the projects and choose one in this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.
INVALID_INPUT: The id is missing or carries a slash. Send the project id as it appears in the projects list.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_project_restore
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose project.restore for review; never apply it to the live books. Put back a project that project.delete removed, from the row the server kept; do not use it to overwrite a project that exists — that is a project.update.
Example input: {"id":"proj_web"}
CONFLICT: A project with this id already exists. Keep the project that is there, or delete it first to restore the older row.
NOT_FOUND: Nothing is on record for this id in this workspace. Check the id, and that the project was deleted from this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.
INVALID_INPUT: The row has no id, or carries an id with a slash. Send the project row that project.delete answered with.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_query_ask
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose query.ask for review; never apply it to the live books. Ask a client or an accountant about one entry in the books; do not use it to change the entry — the answer is what changes it.
Example input: {"transactionId":"tx_123","question":"What was this charge for?"}
INVALID_INPUT: The question is shorter than three characters or longer than the limit. Write the question in a sentence or two.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is a viewer (viewers answer, they do not ask). Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper to put the question.
CONFLICT: The entry already has the most open questions it may have. Close one of them first.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_query_close
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose query.close for review; never apply it to the live books. Close a question about an entry once it is answered; do not use it to delete the conversation — it stays in the record.
Example input: {"queryId":"cq_123"}
FORBIDDEN: The caller neither asked it nor is an owner or an accountant. Ask the person who asked, or an owner, to close it.
NOT_FOUND: The question is not in this workspace. Check the question in this workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_query_reply
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose query.reply for review; never apply it to the live books. Answer a question about an entry, or follow it up; do not use it to close the conversation — that is query.close.
Example input: {"queryId":"cq_123","text":"That was the bank fee for the wire."}
INVALID_INPUT: The answer is empty or longer than the limit. Write the answer in a sentence or two.
CONFLICT: The question is closed, or the conversation has as many messages as it may have. Close it and ask again if it matters.
NOT_FOUND: The question is not in this workspace. Check the question in this workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_reconciliations_bankline
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose reconciliations.bankline for review; never apply it to the live books. Change a bank line the feed brought in — its note, its suggestion or its matched entry; do not use it to edit a posted entry — that is reconciliations.reconcile.
Example input: {"id":"bankline_123","data":{"status":"matched","matchedTransactionId":"tx_123"}}
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper of the workspace. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper.
NOT_FOUND: The bank line, or the entry it is matched to, is not in this workspace. Sync the feed again or check the ids.
CONFLICT: The bank line is dated in a closed period. Reopen the period or leave the line as it is.
INVALID_INPUT: A field is not one a bank line allows, or a value has the wrong shape. Send only the fields listed in the schema.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_reconciliations_banklinepay
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose reconciliations.banklinepay for review; never apply it to the live books. Pay one or more invoices or bills with a deposit a bank line brought in; do not use it to spread a line over accounts — that is reconciliations.banklinesplit.
Example input: {"id":"bankline_123","allocations":[{"documentId":"invoice_123","amountCents":5000}]}
NOT_FOUND: The bank line is not in this workspace. Sync the feed again or check the line id.
CONFLICT: The line is already matched, or it is in another currency. Pick a pending line in the books' currency.
INVALID_INPUT: The documents are not all for the same customer or vendor, or they add up to more than the line. Allocate at most the line's amount to one party.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_reconciliations_banklinesplit
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose reconciliations.banklinesplit for review; never apply it to the live books. Spread one bank line over several accounts, such as a card payment that is part supplies and part fuel; do not use it to pay an invoice — that is reconciliations.banklinepay.
Example input: {"id":"bankline_123","splits":[{"accountId":"acc_supplies","amountCents":3000},{"accountId":"acc_fuel","amountCents":2000}]}
NOT_FOUND: The bank line is not in this workspace. Sync the feed again or check the line id.
CONFLICT: The line is already matched, or it is in another currency. Pick a pending line in the books' currency.
INVALID_INPUT: The splits do not add up to the line, or one names the bank account itself. Make the splits add up to the line and use another account.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_reconciliations_bankrules
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose reconciliations.bankrules for review; never apply it to the live books. Run the workspace's bank rules again over the pending lines to refresh their suggestions; it only suggests, so do not use it to match a line.
Example input: {"limit":200}
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is not found. Check the workspace id.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_reconciliations_clear
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose reconciliations.clear for review; never apply it to the live books. Mark bank entries as cleared against the statement, or take the mark back again; do not use it to change an amount — correct the entry instead.
Example input: {"transactionIds":["tx_123","tx_124"],"clearanceDate":"2026-11-01"}
INVALID_INPUT: The list is empty, over 500, or the clearance date is not a date. Send 1 to 500 entry ids and a date (YYYY-MM-DD).
NOT_FOUND: One of the entries is not there. Refresh the list of uncleared entries.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper.
CONFLICT: The clearance date is before an entry's own date. Use the entry's date or a later one.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_reconciliations_complete
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose reconciliations.complete for review; never apply it to the live books. Finish a bank reconciliation: keep the statement record and mark every entry it covered as reconciled and cleared; do not use it before the statement actually agrees.
Example input: {"accountId":"acc_bank","statementDate":"2026-10-31","statementBalanceCents":125000,"reconciledTransactionIds":["tx_123"]}
NOT_FOUND: The account or one of the entries is not in this workspace. Use the account and entries of this workspace.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper, or an entry is not this workspace's. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper.
INVALID_INPUT: An entry is a draft or void, or the statement date is not a date. Pick posted entries and a real statement date.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The statement date falls in a closed period. Use a statement date in an open period.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_reconciliations_reconcile
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose reconciliations.reconcile for review; never apply it to the live books. Match, unmatch or correct bank lines and entries as one reconciliation batch; do not use it to post a new bill or invoice — that is documents.post.
Example input: {"operations":[{"id":"bankline_123","type":"updateBankLine","data":{"status":"matched","matchedTransactionId":"tx_123"}}]}
INVALID_INPUT: An operation has no id, an unknown type, or the batch is empty or over 250. Send between 1 and 250 operations, each with an id and a known type.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is not found. Check the workspace id.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper of the workspace. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper.
PERIOD_LOCKED: A line or entry in the batch is dated in a closed period. Use dates in an open period.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_record_delete
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose record.delete for review; never apply it to the live books. Delete one ordinary record (a purchase order, a recurring rule, a tax rate, a project, an asset, an estimate, an inventory item or a loan note); a ledger collection is refused and keeps its own command.
Example input: {"collection":"taxRates","id":"tax-1"}
INVALID_INPUT: The collection is not an ordinary record. Use the command that owns that collection.
NOT_FOUND: The record is not in the selected workspace. Reload the list and try the row you can see.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper to delete it.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_record_fields
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose record.fields for review; never apply it to the live books. Change the non-financial fields a screen edits in place — a name, an address, a note, a planning budget — and refuse if someone else changed them first; do not use it for an amount on a document, a posting date or a status, which the record’s own command owns.
Example input: {"collection":"customers","id":"cust-1","fields":{"address":"14 Herzl St, Tel Aviv"},"expected":{"address":""}}
INVALID_INPUT: The collection is not editable in place, the field is not named for that collection, the value is not text, a number, a switch, a null or a list, or the value breaks the field’s own rule — a blank required name, a negative or fractional planning amount, a status a project does not have, an impossible date, an address-shaped email or a tag Code 128 cannot print. Send a field the screen offers with a value its editor would accept, or use the command that owns the field.
NOT_FOUND: The record is not in the selected workspace. Reload the list and open a record in this workspace.
CONFLICT: The field no longer holds the value the caller read, or the record is an estimate that is no longer a draft. Reload the record, then save again — an issued estimate keeps the number and dates it was issued with.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper to change the record.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_record_save
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose record.save for review; never apply it to the live books. Create or save a whole ordinary record — a purchase order, a recurring rule, a tax rate, a project, an asset, an estimate, an inventory item or a loan note — and never a ledger collection, whose own command owns the postings.
Example input: {"collection":"purchaseOrders","id":"po-1","data":{"status":"approved"},"unset":["binLocations.store-1"]}
INVALID_INPUT: The collection is not an ordinary record, the record is empty or too large, or a field name is empty. Use the command that owns that collection, or send the fields the screen shows.
NOT_FOUND: The record is not in the selected workspace, or a save names an id that does not exist without asking to create it. Reload the list and open a record in this workspace.
CONFLICT: A create names an id that is already taken, or the save changes a field only a ledger command may change (asset depreciation or disposal, stock or cost of a stocked item, an accepted estimate, a received purchase order). Open that record and save it, or let the server choose the id.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper to save the record.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_reportschedule_preview
propose_reportschedule_send
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose reportschedule.send for review; never apply it to the live books. Send a scheduled report now, in addition to its own time; do not use it to re-send one that already went — check the schedule first.
Example input: {"scheduleId":"sched_1"}
NOT_FOUND: No schedule with that id in this workspace. Reload the schedules.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is a bookkeeper or a viewer. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_revenue_recognize
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose revenue.recognize for review; never apply it to the live books. Recognise revenue under ASC 606, moving an amount out of the deferred balance and into income; do not use it to invoice a customer — that is an invoice.
Example input: {"amountCents":250000,"deferredAccountId":"acc_deferred","revenueAccountId":"acc_revenue","contractId":"C-14","periodId":"2026-01","date":"2026-01-31"}
INVALID_INPUT: The amount is not a positive whole number of cents, or an account or the date is missing. Send the amount in whole cents, both accounts and a YYYY-MM-DD date.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The posting date falls in a closed period. Choose an open date or ask an owner to reopen the period.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_rma_move
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose rma.move for review; never apply it to the live books. Move a return authorization on — approve it, decline it, record the goods received, or link the credit note; do not use it to skip receiving the goods before a credit note.
Example input: {"customerId":"cust_123","rmaId":"rma_123","action":"approve","expectedStatus":"requested","requestKey":"rma-approve-1"}
CONFLICT: Someone else moved it since it was read (it is no longer the expected status). Reload the RMA and look again.
FORBIDDEN: The caller may not approve or close this RMA. Ask an owner or an accountant.
NOT_FOUND: The RMA is not this customer’s, or not in this workspace. Check the customer and the RMA number.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_rma_request
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose rma.request for review; never apply it to the live books. Record a customer’s request to return goods against an issued invoice and give it an RMA number; do not use it to post the credit — the goods are received first.
Example input: {"customerId":"cust_123","invoiceId":"invoice_123","reason":"Damaged in transit","lines":[{"invoiceLineId":"line_1","quantity":2}],"requestKey":"rma-2026-06-30-1"}
INVALID_INPUT: A line is not a stock line of the invoice, or the request key is not 8–100 letters, digits, - or _. Send stock lines of that invoice and a fresh request key.
CONFLICT: The invoice is not issued, or more is returned than was sold. Return no more than the invoice still sold.
NOT_FOUND: The customer or the invoice is not in this workspace. Check the customer and invoice in this workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_savedlist_allocationrules
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose savedlist.allocationrules for review; never apply it to the live books. Replace the workspace's split rules, which decide how an expense is spread over accounts; do not use it to change one bill — set its lines instead.
Example input: {"rules":[{"id":"ar_1","name":"Half and half","match":"rent","shares":[{"percent":50},{"percent":50}]}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A rule has no name or match, or its shares do not add up. Fix the named rule; shares add up to 100.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is not found. Check the workspace.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_savedlist_approvaldelegate
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose savedlist.approvaldelegate for review; never apply it to the live books. Hand your invoice approvals to another person until a date, or take the hand-over back; do not use it to give someone a role.
Example input: {"to":"uid_accountant","until":"2026-12-31"}
INVALID_INPUT: The person is missing, or the date is not a real future day and clear is not set. Send to and until, or clear: true.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace, or the person in it, is not found. Choose a member of this workspace.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_savedlist_customergroup
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose savedlist.customergroup for review; never apply it to the live books. Add, rename, re-price or remove one of the workspace's customer groups; do not use it to move a customer to another group.
Example input: {"op":"add","name":"Wholesale","paymentTerms":30}
INVALID_INPUT: The operation is unknown or a required field is missing. Send add, rename, setTerms or remove with the fields it needs.
CONFLICT: The name is already a group, or the group still has customers. Choose another name, or move its customers first.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_savedlist_paymenttype
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose savedlist.paymenttype for review; never apply it to the live books. Add, rename or remove one of the workspace's payment types; do not use it to record a payment.
Example input: {"op":"add","name":"Cheque","method":"cheque"}
INVALID_INPUT: The operation is unknown, the name is empty, or the method is not a payment method. Send add, rename or remove with the fields it needs.
CONFLICT: The name is already a payment type, or the type is in use. Choose another name, or keep a type that payments use.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_savedlist_pricelists
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose savedlist.pricelists for review; never apply it to the live books. Replace the workspace's price lists, which set an item's price for a customer group or currency; do not use it to change one invoice line.
Example input: {"lists":[{"id":"pl_1","name":"Wholesale","currency":"USD","items":[{"itemId":"item_1","unitPriceCents":900}]}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A list has no name, or an entry has no price. Fix the named list.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is not found. Check the workspace.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_savedlist_roledashboard
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose savedlist.roledashboard for review; never apply it to the live books. Set the dashboard a role starts on when someone opens the workspace; do not use it to change a person's own layout.
Example input: {"role":"owner","layout":["cash","profit"]}
INVALID_INPUT: The role is missing or unknown, or the layout is not a list. Name a real role and send a layout array.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is not found. Check the workspace.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_savedlist_salesreps
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose savedlist.salesreps for review; never apply it to the live books. Replace the workspace's sales reps, whom an invoice can credit; do not use it to change a person's sign-in — that is a workspace role.
Example input: {"reps":[{"id":"rep_1","name":"Dana Levi"}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A rep has no name. Give each rep a name.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is not found. Check the workspace.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_savedlist_taxprofiles
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose savedlist.taxprofiles for review; never apply it to the live books. Replace the tax profiles the books and label values use, each a rate and the accounts it posts to; do not use it to re-file a tax return.
Example input: {"profiles":[{"id":"vat17","name":"VAT 17%","ratePercent":17,"liabilityAccountId":"acc_vat"}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A profile has no name or rate, or names an account that is not in the books. Fix the named profile and its account.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is not found. Check the workspace.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_security_twoperson
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose security.twoperson for review; never apply it to the live books. Turn the two-person rule on or off, so that whoever prepares a payment or pay run cannot also approve it; do not use it to approve one — that is the approve command.
High risk: the person must confirm this step alone with two-step sign-in.
Example input: {"on":true}
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner. Ask a workspace owner.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_security_twostep
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose security.twostep for review; never apply it to the live books. Require (or stop requiring) two-step login for everyone in the workspace; do not use it to turn on your own second factor — that is your account settings.
High risk: the person must confirm this step alone with two-step sign-in.
Example input: {"required":true}
FORBIDDEN: The caller is not an owner, or has not confirmed two-step login themselves. Ask an owner who signs in with two steps.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_stages_define
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose stages.define for review; never apply it to the live books. Define the workspace-specific invoice and bill progress stages without changing document status or the books; do not use it to mark an invoice paid.
Example input: {"sets":{"invoice":["Draft","For review","Sent"],"bill":["Received","Checked","Ready to pay"]}}
INVALID_INPUT: A stage list has an unsupported kind, duplicate, empty name, or more than 12 stages. Use only invoice and bill lists with unique names up to 40 characters.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to define stages.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_stages_move
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose stages.move for review; never apply it to the live books. Move an invoice or bill to one of its configured progress stages, or clear the stage; do not use it to change its accounting status.
Example input: {"kind":"bill","id":"bill_123","stage":"Checked"}
INVALID_INPUT: The record kind, id, or chosen stage is invalid. Choose an invoice or bill and one of its configured stages, or send an empty stage to clear it.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace bookkeeper or above to move the stage.
NOT_FOUND: The invoice or bill is not in this workspace. Reload the workspace and choose an existing document.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_support_message
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose support.message for review; never apply it to the live books. Add a message to a support ticket and move its unread flags and stage; do not use it to open a ticket, which support.ticket does.
Example input: {"ticketId":"feedback-1","body":"Here is the screenshot you asked for"}
INVALID_INPUT: The message is empty or over 5000 characters. Send a message of 1–5000 characters.
NOT_FOUND: The ticket is not in the selected workspace. Reload support and choose a ticket in this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller sends `authorRole: admin` without the platform role. Reply as a user, or ask an administrator to answer.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_support_platformstatus
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose support.platformstatus for review; never apply it to the live books. Change the stage of a support ticket as a platform administrator without sending a reply or marking it read.
Example input: {"ticketId":"ticket_1","status":"resolved"}
ADMIN_REQUIRED: Only platform support can use this command. Ask the platform support team to triage the ticket.
NOT_FOUND: The ticket no longer exists. Reload the support queue.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_support_reply
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose support.reply for review; never apply it to the live books. Reply to an existing support thread as its opener, a workspace member, or platform support; do not use this to open a new ticket.
Example input: {"ticketId":"ticket_1","body":"Here is the missing detail.","authorRole":"user"}
NOT_FOUND: The ticket no longer exists. Open an existing support thread.
NOT_A_MEMBER: The caller neither opened the thread nor belongs to its workspace. Choose a thread you can access.
ADMIN_REQUIRED: A caller without the platform role wants to reply as support. Reply as yourself.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_support_status
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose support.status for review; never apply it to the live books. Move a support ticket’s stage (open, waiting on either side, resolved, closed); do not use it to write to the ticket’s conversation.
Example input: {"ticketId":"feedback-1","status":"resolved"}
NOT_FOUND: The ticket is not in the selected workspace. Reload support and choose a ticket in this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to triage the ticket.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_support_ticket
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose support.ticket for review; never apply it to the live books. Open a support ticket with the message that describes the problem, in one step; do not use it to reply — support.message does that.
Example input: {"id":"feedback-1","subject":"Feedback: Reports","body":"The totals do not add up"}
INVALID_INPUT: There is no subject or no message, or the message is over 5000 characters. Send a subject and a message of 1–5000 characters.
CONFLICT: That ticket id already belongs to another workspace. Let the screen mint a fresh id and try again.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_tag_change
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose tag.change for review; never apply it to the live books. Rename a tag across the workspace, merge it into an existing name, or remove it from every row; do not use it to change what a row is — only the label it carries.
Example input: {"from":"Travel","to":"Travel & meals"}
INVALID_INPUT: The old name is blank, the new name is longer than 50 characters, or the body has an extra field. Send just `from` and `to` (null removes the tag).
FORBIDDEN: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_tasks_create
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose tasks.create for review; never apply it to the live books. Create a task for a workspace teammate, optionally linked to a record and due date; do not use it to change a ledger record.
Example input: {"task":{"title":"Review the Acme invoice","assignee":"user_123","due":"2026-12-01","record":{"type":"invoice","id":"invoice_123","label":"Invoice INV-12"}}}
INVALID_INPUT: The task details are incomplete or malformed. Provide a clear title, a workspace assignee, and an optional valid due date or record.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not allowed to assign tasks. Ask an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper to create the task.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace or assignee does not exist in this workspace. Reload the workspace members and select an existing teammate.
CONFLICT: The workspace already has the maximum number of open tasks. Complete or remove an open task before creating another.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_tasks_remove
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose tasks.remove for review; never apply it to the live books. Remove a task you created or any task as the workspace owner; do not use this for deleting an invoice, bill, or other financial record.
Example input: {"taskId":"task_123"}
NOT_FOUND: The task is not in the selected workspace. Reload the task list and choose an existing task.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller did not create this task and is not the workspace owner. Ask the task creator or workspace owner to remove it.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_tasks_status
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose tasks.status for review; never apply it to the live books. Mark a task done or open again when you made it, were assigned it, or own the workspace; do not use it to edit the task details.
Example input: {"taskId":"task_123","status":"done"}
INVALID_INPUT: The requested status is not open or done. Use status open or done.
NOT_FOUND: The task is not in the selected workspace. Reload the task list and choose an existing task.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller did not create or receive this task and is not a workspace owner. Ask the task creator, assignee, or workspace owner to change its status.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_tax_file
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose tax.file for review; never apply it to the live books. Compute and keep the tax return for a period you name; do not use it to correct a return already filed — file a later one that covers the correction.
Example input: {"startDate":"2026-01-01","endDate":"2026-03-31","reference":"Q1 2026"}
INVALID_INPUT: A date is not YYYY-MM-DD, the period is backwards, or the registration is not shaped like `vat:XX:123`. Send both dates and, if you mean one registration, its full id.
NOT_FOUND: The registration is not one this workspace holds for that period. Check the registration id on the tax profile, or leave it out to file for the whole workspace.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is a bookkeeper or a viewer. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_time_invoice
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose time.invoice for review; never apply it to the live books. Lock approved billable time to a draft invoice after its lines have been added; do not use this command to create invoice lines or post the invoice.
Example input: {"entryIds":["time_123"],"invoiceId":"invoice_123"}
INVALID_INPUT: The invoice id or time-entry list is missing or malformed. Choose a draft invoice and between 1 and 500 time-entry ids.
NOT_FOUND: The invoice or a time entry is not in the selected workspace. Reload the invoice and time list and select records from this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace bookkeeper or above to invoice time.
CONFLICT: An entry is not approved billable time waiting for this invoice. Approve the time first or remove its existing invoice assignment.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_time_log
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose time.log for review; never apply it to the live books. Log your work time or, as an owner or accountant, time for another workspace member; do not use this to post an invoice.
Example input: {"entry":{"date":"2026-11-15","minutes":90,"description":"Prepare the monthly close","billable":false}}
INVALID_INPUT: The date, duration, description, customer, or rate is invalid. Use a real YYYY-MM-DD date, 1 to 1440 whole minutes, a short description, and valid optional fields.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller tries to log for another person without an approver role. Log time for yourself or ask an owner or accountant.
NOT_FOUND: The selected person or workspace does not exist. Reload workspace members and select a current member.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_time_move
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose time.move for review; never apply it to the live books. Submit your open time, withdraw your submitted time, or approve or send back time as an owner or accountant; do not use it to invoice time.
Example input: {"entryIds":["time_123","time_124"],"to":"approved"}
INVALID_INPUT: The target state or list of entries is invalid. Choose submitted, open, or approved and between 1 and 500 entry ids.
NOT_FOUND: An entry is not in the selected workspace. Reload the time list and retry with entries from this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller cannot move one of the selected entries. Submit or withdraw your own time, or ask an owner or accountant to approve it.
CONFLICT: An entry is not in the requested state or was paid in a pay run. Resolve the conflicting entry or undo the pay run before retrying.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_time_rates
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose time.rates for review; never apply it to the live books. Set hourly rates by project, customer, or person for future time-value calculations; do not use this to edit the rate stored on an individual entry.
Example input: {"rates":{"projects":{"project_1":9500},"customers":{"customer_1":8000},"people":{"user_1":7000}}}
INVALID_INPUT: A rate is missing, negative, fractional, or the maps are too large. Use nonnegative whole cents per hour in maps of up to 2,000 entries.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to maintain hourly rates.
NOT_FOUND: The selected workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_time_remove
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose time.remove for review; never apply it to the live books. Remove an open entry you own or an entry an owner or accountant may edit; do not use this to remove invoiced or payroll-paid time.
Example input: {"entryId":"time_123"}
NOT_FOUND: The time entry is not in the selected workspace. Reload the time list and select an existing entry.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller cannot edit this entry or it is locked. Ask an owner or accountant to review submitted time; invoiced or paid entries cannot be removed here.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_time_update
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose time.update for review; never apply it to the live books. Edit an open entry you own or any entry as an owner or accountant; do not use it to change an entry already invoiced or paid.
Example input: {"entryId":"time_123","entry":{"minutes":120,"description":"Prepare the monthly close"}}
INVALID_INPUT: One or more supplied time fields are invalid. Correct the date, minutes, description, customer, or hourly rate.
NOT_FOUND: The time entry is not in the selected workspace. Reload the time list and select an existing entry.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller does not own an open entry and is not an owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to update submitted time.
CONFLICT: The entry has already been invoiced. Edit the draft invoice or create a separate adjustment instead.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_transaction_reset
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose transaction.reset for review; never apply it to the live books. Empty a workspace that holds only demo data, so its sample books can be loaded again; do not use it to clear real books — delete the workspace instead, which keeps it for 30 days first.
High risk: the person must confirm this step alone with two-step sign-in.
Example input: {"workspaceId":"ws_123","confirmReset":true}
CONFLICT: The workspace does not hold demo data, so its books are real. Delete the workspace instead (Settings → Security); it is kept for 30 days first.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not the workspace owner. Ask the workspace owner.
INVALID_INPUT: confirmReset was not sent as true. Send confirmReset: true to say the deletion is intended.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_user_aikeyremove
propose_user_aikeyset
propose_user_preferences
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose user.preferences for review; never apply it to the live books. Save the signed-in person’s own notice settings and report layouts on their profile; do not use it to change a workspace setting or someone else’s profile.
Example input: {"notificationPrefs":{"emailDigest":true,"digestHour":8}}
INVALID_INPUT: Nothing was named, or a notice is not a scalar or a report layout has no scope. Send the notices, or one report’s scope key and layout.
UNAUTHENTICATED: The request has no signed-in person. Sign in and run the command again.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_user_provision
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose user.provision for review; never apply it to the live books. Create the signed-in person’s own profile row if it is missing; do not use it to change a name, an email or a role — those are set elsewhere.
Example input: {}
INVALID_INPUT: The input carries any field. Send an empty object: the profile is built from the signed-in person.
UNAUTHENTICATED: The request has no signed-in person. Sign in and run the command again.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_vendor_balance
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose vendor.balance for review; never apply it to the live books. Recompute the stored balance of a vendor (what we still owe) from the open documents the workspace holds, so a cached total cannot disagree with the records; do not use it to post, pay or settle anything.
Example input: {"id":"vendor_123"}
NOT_FOUND: The contact is not in the selected workspace. Reload the contact list and choose a contact in this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_vendor_create
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose vendor.create for review; never apply it to the live books. Create a vendor contact for bills and payments; do not use this command to record a bill payment or change a vendor balance.
Example input: {"vendor":{"name":"Paper Co","category":"Office Supplies","currency":"USD"}}
INVALID_INPUT: The vendor name or a supplied profile field is invalid. Correct the vendor details and retry.
DUPLICATE_RECORD: The supplied vendor id is already used. Choose a new id or load the existing vendor.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_vendor_update
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose vendor.update for review; never apply it to the live books. Update a vendor profile without changing its server-managed balance or recording a bill payment.
Example input: {"id":"vendor_123","data":{"email":"ap@example.test","category":"Office Supplies"}}
INVALID_INPUT: The vendor id or one of the supplied fields is invalid. Correct the vendor details and retry.
NOT_FOUND: The vendor is not in the selected workspace. Reload the workspace and choose an existing vendor.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_vendorcredit_create
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose vendorcredit.create for review; never apply it to the live books. Create a vendor credit and let the server build its ledger entries from the saved document; do not use this command to record a payment or edit an existing vendor credit.
Example input: {"vendorCredit":{"vendorId":"vendor_123","vendorName":"Paper Co","number":"VC-1001","billId":"bill_123","date":"2026-11-15","status":"open","amountCents":11800,"remainingCents":11800,"currency":"USD"}}
INVALID_INPUT: The document is missing required fields or contains an invalid amount, date, or line. Correct the document details and retry with a new operation key.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The document date or a posting it would reverse is closed for this person. Choose an open date or ask an authorized owner to reopen the period.
CONFLICT: Another save changed or posted this document before the command committed. Reload the document and review the current ledger before retrying.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_vendorcredit_delete
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose vendorcredit.delete for review; never apply it to the live books. Delete a vendor credit and let the server reverse its live ledger entries; do not use this command to void or write off a document.
Example input: {"id":"document_123"}
INVALID_INPUT: The document is missing required fields or contains an invalid amount, date, or line. Correct the document details and retry with a new operation key.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The document date or a posting it would reverse is closed for this person. Choose an open date or ask an authorized owner to reopen the period.
CONFLICT: Another save changed or posted this document before the command committed. Reload the document and review the current ledger before retrying.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_vendorcredit_update
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose vendorcredit.update for review; never apply it to the live books. Update an existing vendor credit and let the server rebuild or preserve its ledger entries; do not use this command to apply or refund a credit.
Example input: {"id":"document_123","data":{"status":"draft"}}
INVALID_INPUT: The document is missing required fields or contains an invalid amount, date, or line. Correct the document details and retry with a new operation key.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The document date or a posting it would reverse is closed for this person. Choose an open date or ask an authorized owner to reopen the period.
CONFLICT: Another save changed or posted this document before the command committed. Reload the document and review the current ledger before retrying.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_warranty_update
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose warranty.update for review; never apply it to the live books. Set the warranty end date for a serial on an issued invoice and preserve who changed it; do not use this command to change inventory, invoices, or posted amounts.
Example input: {"candidate":{"id":"w_example","workspaceId":"workspace_123","customerId":"customer_123","invoiceId":"invoice_123","invoiceLineId":"line_1","itemId":"item_1","serial":"SN-100"},"endDate":"2028-01-15"}
INVALID_INPUT: The selected serial or warranty end date is invalid. Choose an issued invoice serial and enter a real calendar date.
CONFLICT: The customer, invoice line, or serial changed before the update. Reload the warranty register and select the current serial row.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_watches_create
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose watches.create for review; never apply it to the live books. Watch an invoice, bill, ledger entry, account, or item for later change notices; do not use this to edit the record.
Example input: {"record":{"type":"invoice","id":"invoice_123","label":"Invoice INV-12"}}
INVALID_INPUT: The selected record reference or label is malformed. Provide a supported record type, its id, and a display label.
NOT_FOUND: The record is not in this workspace. Reload the workspace and select an existing record.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not a member of the workspace. Ask a workspace owner to add you before watching records.
NOT_A_MEMBER: The command runner cannot verify the caller as a workspace member. Ask a workspace owner to add you, then reload the workspace.
CONFLICT: The caller is already watching the maximum number of records. Stop watching an older record first.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_watches_remove
propose_workspace_addmember
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.addmember for review; never apply it to the live books. Add a person to a workspace by user id or email; do not use it to assign a role, which is a separate action.
Example input: {"memberUid":"user_123"}
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner. Ask a workspace owner.
INVALID_INPUT: Neither user id nor email is given. Send one of them.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_apicreate
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.apicreate for review; never apply it to the live books. Create a new workspace for the signed-in person through the developer API; do not use it to edit an existing workspace.
Example input: {"fields":{"name":"New books","currency":"USD"}}
FORBIDDEN: The API key is restricted to an existing workspace. Sign in as a person or use an unscoped key.
INVALID_INPUT: The workspace fields fail validation. Correct the workspace fields.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_applytemplate
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.applytemplate for review; never apply it to the live books. Replace a new workspace's chart of accounts with a template's, or add the template's missing accounts to a workspace that already has entries; do not use it to edit one account — use accounts.update.
Example input: {"templateId":"consulting"}
INVALID_INPUT: Both templateId and accounts are sent, or neither, or no account is valid. Send either a templateId or the accounts, at least one with a name and a type.
NOT_FOUND: No such template, or the workspace does not exist. Choose a listed template.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to apply it.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_branding
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.branding for review; never apply it to the live books. Save the logo, colour, address, footer and payment terms printed on documents; it changes what documents look like, never what they say.
Example input: {"branding":{"color":"#1F6FEB","footer":"Thank you"}}
INVALID_INPUT: The logo is too large or not an image, the colour is not a hex colour, or a field is not one of the branding fields. Fix the field the answer names.
FORBIDDEN: The caller is a bookkeeper or a viewer. Ask an owner or an accountant.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_budgetcontrol
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.budgetcontrol for review; never apply it to the live books. Set whether over-budget posting is ignored, warned or blocked; do not use it to change a budget amount.
Example input: {"budgetControl":"block"}
INVALID_INPUT: The mode is not off, warn or block. Choose one of the three modes.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not the workspace owner. Ask the owner to change this setting.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_canceldeletion
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.canceldeletion for review; never apply it to the live books. Cancel a pending workspace deletion and restore access; do not use this to undo individual record changes.
Example input: {}
WORKSPACE_NOT_PENDING_DELETION: The workspace is not scheduled for deletion. Choose a workspace currently marked pending deletion.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not the workspace owner. Ask the workspace owner to restore the workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_create
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.create for review; never apply it to the live books. Open a new empty workspace that you own; do not use it to copy, import or seed another workspace’s books — an import is its own command.
Example input: {"name":"Personal Workspace","businessType":"personal","currency":"USD","personal":true}
INVALID_INPUT: The currency is not three letters, or the input carries unexpected fields. Send a name, a business type and a three-letter currency, or nothing at all.
UNAUTHENTICATED: The request has no signed-in person. Sign in and run the command again.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_dimensionaxes
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.dimensionaxes for review; never apply it to the live books. Replace the list of labels the workspace groups by (property, class, location, …); existing values and the transactions that carry them are untouched.
Example input: {"dimensions":[{"id":"property","name":"Property"},{"id":"class","name":"Class"}]}
CONFLICT: A label id appears twice in the list. Send one entry per label.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is no longer open. Reload the workspace and try again.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_dimensionnode
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.dimensionnode for review; never apply it to the live books. Save one value of a workspace label, or change its name, aliases, parent or status; do not use it to move or relabel transactions that already carry the value.
Example input: {"node":{"id":"P1","dimensionId":"property","description":"123 Ocean Ave Maint"}}
INVALID_INPUT: The value has no code or axis, or the change names fields the label does not have. Send the whole value, or only the fields a label carries.
DUPLICATE_RECORD: The chosen code is already in use on a create-only request. Reload the values or choose another code.
NOT_FOUND: The value is not in the selected workspace. Reload the labels and choose a value in this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.

createOnly.description: Refuse an existing label instead of replacing it.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_dimensionnodes
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.dimensionnodes for review; never apply it to the live books. Save a batch of label values the workspace groups by (at most 450 at once); do not use it to move a legacy tree off the workspace row, which workspace.dimensionnodesmigrate does.
Example input: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","dimensionId":"property","description":"North tower"}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A value has no axis or no code, or more than 450 arrive at once. Send at most 450 values, each with its axis and its code.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper to save the values.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_dimensionnodesmigrate
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.dimensionnodesmigrate for review; never apply it to the live books. Move a legacy label tree off the workspace row and into the dimensionNodes collection, clearing the old field in the same transaction; do not use it to add a new value, which workspace.dimensionnode does.
Example input: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","dimensionId":"property","description":"North tower"}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A label has no axis, or more than 450 arrive at once. Send the tree in chunks of at most 450 labels, each with its axis.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace is no longer open. Reload the workspace and try again.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper to run the move.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_importmap
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.importmap for review; never apply it to the live books. Remember how a bank CSV header maps to statement fields for the next import; do not use this to import or change ledger entries.
Example input: {"signature":"csv_5_1234abcd","columns":{"date":"Posted Date","description":"Description","debit":"Debit","credit":"Credit"},"skipRows":1}
INVALID_INPUT: The header signature, mapped columns, or skipped-row count is invalid. Send a csv_<header-count>_<8 lowercase hex digits> signature, only known column names, and skipRows from 0 to 20.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace bookkeeper or above to save the mapping.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace and retry.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_importrecords
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.importrecords for review; never apply it to the live books. Create customers, vendors, items or accounts from a spreadsheet in one go, skipping the ones that already exist; do not use it to change a record — use its own update command.
Example input: {"kind":"customers","rows":[{"Name":"Acme, Inc."}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A row is unusable, the file is empty, or it is longer than the row limit. Check the rows the error lists and send them again.
FORBIDDEN: A bookkeeper imports accounts. Ask an owner or accountant to import the chart.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_invite
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.invite for review; never apply it to the live books. Invite one person by e-mail to join this workspace in a role; do not use it to mint an API key — that is apikey.provision.
Example input: {"email":"sam@example.com","role":"bookkeeper"}
PAYMENT_REQUIRED: The plan has no free seat left. Upgrade the plan or remove a member first.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace does not exist. Choose a workspace you own.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner. Ask an owner to invite them.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_modules
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.modules for review; never apply it to the live books. Turn workspace screens on or off without deleting their records; do not use this to change or remove data in a module.
Example input: {"modules":{"payroll":false,"inventory":true}}
INVALID_INPUT: The module map is malformed or names an unsupported module. Send true or false for a module listed in Settings → Modules.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to change module settings.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_nextnumber
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.nextnumber for review; never apply it to the live books. Reserve the next number in a document series; do not execute it merely to preview a number, because unused allocations remain consumed.
Example input: {"type":"invoice"}
INVALID_INPUT: The requested document type is not a supported numbering series. Choose one of: invoice, bill, estimate, creditNote, vendorCredit, payment.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace bookkeeper or above to reserve a document number.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_openingbalances
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.openingbalances for review; never apply it to the live books. Post the workspace’s starting balance-sheet amounts as one balanced opening entry on the selected date; receivables and payables come from their unpaid documents instead.
Example input: {"date":"2026-01-01","balances":[{"accountId":"account_cash","amountCents":125000},{"accountId":"account_loan","amountCents":30000}]}
INVALID_INPUT: A balance is not a whole-cent amount, an account is duplicated, or an account cannot hold an opening balance. Use one eligible balance-sheet account per line and whole cents; load receivables and payables from unpaid invoices and bills.
PERIOD_LOCKED: The start date is in a locked period. Choose a date after the workspace period lock.
CONFLICT: Opening balances have already been recorded. Reverse the existing opening entry in the ledger before recording a replacement.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to set up the books.
INVALID_INPUT: The workspace has no active Opening Balance Equity account, or an amount or account cannot be used for an opening balance. Add an active Opening Balance Equity account and choose eligible balance-sheet accounts.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The named workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_removemember
functionDeclarations.description:
