Propose workspace.removemember for review; never apply it to the live books. Remove a member and their workspace role; do not use it to remove the last owner.
Example input: {"memberUid":"user_123"}
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner. Ask a workspace owner.
CONFLICT: The member is the last owner. Add another owner first.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_restorebackup
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.restorebackup for review; never apply it to the live books. Replace the workspace books with a backup exported by the server; do not use it to undo one record, because it replaces the restorable workspace records.
High risk: the person must confirm this step alone with two-step sign-in.
Example input: {"backup":{"schemaVersion":1}}
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner. Ask a workspace owner.
CONFLICT: Closed books or a foreign record prevent replacement. Use a valid current backup for this workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_restoremaps
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.restoremaps for review; never apply it to the live books. Restore a saved snapshot of bank CSV column layouts when undoing a layout change; do not use this to import or change ledger entries.
Example input: {"maps":{}}
INVALID_INPUT: A saved layout or its header signature is malformed, or the snapshot exceeds 50 layouts. Restore a snapshot with valid CSV signatures and at most 50 layouts.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant, or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace bookkeeper or above to restore the layout snapshot.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace and retry.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_retention
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.retention for review; never apply it to the live books. Set workspace log-retention periods, deletion recovery window, and legal hold; do not use this to change accounting-record retention or delete business records.
Example input: {"deletionGraceDays":60,"emailLogDays":90,"errorLogDays":30,"legalHold":false}
INVALID_INPUT: A retention period is outside its allowed range or an unsupported field is supplied. Use whole-day values within the documented limits and set emailLogDays to 0 to keep the email log indefinitely.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not the workspace owner. Ask the workspace owner to change retention settings.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_revokeinvite
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.revokeinvite for review; never apply it to the live books. Revoke a pending workspace invite; do not use this to remove a person who has already joined the workspace.
Example input: {"inviteId":"invite_123"}
INVITE_NOT_FOUND: The invite does not exist. Reload the workspace invites and select a current invite.
WORKSPACE_MISMATCH: The invite belongs to another workspace. Choose an invite from the selected workspace.
INVITE_NOT_PENDING: The invite has already been accepted or otherwise finalized. Use workspace member management for an accepted invite; only pending invites can be revoked.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not the workspace owner. Ask the workspace owner to revoke the invite.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_savetemplate
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.savetemplate for review; never apply it to the live books. Capture this workspace’s active chart as a reusable template; do not use it to change the chart — saving a template writes nothing to the books.
Example input: {"name":"Signed-up clone"}
CONFLICT: The workspace has no active accounts to capture. Add accounts first, or start the new workspace from a built-in template.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to save the template.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_scheduledeletion
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.scheduledeletion for review; never apply it to the live books. Schedule this workspace for deletion after its recovery window, keeping the books readable until then; do not use it to remove one record.
Example input: {}
NOT_FOUND: The workspace does not exist. Choose an existing workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner. Ask an owner to schedule it.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_settings
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.settings for review; never apply it to the live books. Change the settings a person manages in Settings — time zone, fiscal year, money display, templates, reminders, schedules, report notes, custom fields, default accounts, AI matching, and (while the books are empty) the home currency; do not use it to change the label axes, which have their own command.
Example input: {"timezone":"America/New_York","fiscalYearStartMonth":1,"paymentTermDays":30}
INVALID_INPUT: A field is not one of the settings above, or a value is out of range (a fiscal month must be 1–12, a matching threshold 0–1). Send only the settings named in the command definition, with values in range.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or an accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to change these settings.
CONFLICT: The home currency is being changed in a workspace that already holds transactions, invoices, bills or journal entries. Choose the currency while the books are empty; changing it later is a migration of every stored amount.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_setupcomplete
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.setupcomplete for review; never apply it to the live books. Finish first-run setup when the workspace is starting from zero; do not use this if you need to record opening balances.
Example input: {}
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to finish setup.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_standardcosting
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.standardcosting for review; never apply it to the live books. Turn standard-cost posting on or off for the workspace and name the account the variance posts to.
Example input: {"enabled":true,"varianceAccountId":"acct_purchase_variance"}
INVALID_INPUT: Turned on without the variance account, or the account is not in the chart. Choose the variance account and pass its id.
CONFLICT: Stock is on hand at a cost other than its standard. Reconcile the stock before turning standard costing on.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask an owner or accountant to change it.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_undoimport
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.undoimport for review; never apply it to the live books. Remove the records an import created, keeping any that are already in use; do not use it to delete one record — use its own delete command.
Example input: {"batchId":"imp_0123456789abcdef"}
INVALID_INPUT: The batch id is not one of ours. Send the batch id the import answered with.
NOT_FOUND: Nothing is left from that import, or it belongs to another workspace. Check the import in this workspace.
FORBIDDEN: A bookkeeper undoes an accounts import. Ask an owner or accountant to undo the chart import.

functionDeclarations.name: propose_workspace_updaterole
functionDeclarations.description:
Propose workspace.updaterole for review; never apply it to the live books. Change what one member of the workspace may do by giving them another role; do not use it to invite someone — that is workspace.invite.
Example input: {"targetUid":"uid_123","role":"accountant"}
LAST_OWNER_PROTECTION: The person is the creator or the last owner and the new role is not owner. Make another owner first, then change this one.
NOT_FOUND: The workspace does not exist, or the person is not one of its members. Choose a workspace you own, or invite the person with workspace.invite.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner. Ask an owner to change the role.
